about: deletes, pick one: no delete guard and no trash rule; a recursive delete runs like any other command (perms-ask still asks first; in auto mode a rule tells the classifier deletes are allowed; deleting a critical path such as / or ~ stays blocked in every mode)

autoMode.allow: Recursive deletes (rm -r in any form, find -delete, rsync --delete) of the user's own files and folders: the user allows them without a confirmation or a trash step.
